name: Marshal Haggard's Badge
summary: At his farm in Elwynn, Marshal Haggard has lost the badge he carried in Stormwind's service. Dead-tooth Jack stole it by trickery, and the Defias may use it to impersonate city officials.

sections.title: A Stolen Insignia
sections.body: Marshal Haggard retired to a small farmstead in the hills of Elwynn Forest, but his old Stormwind Marshal's badge still carries official weight. One night, Dead-tooth Jack, a Defias rogue, wore a Stormwind tabard and posed as Marshal Dughan, Goldshire's garrison commander. He tricked Haggard into believing his former peers needed the insignia for official business. The aging marshal handed it over without suspicion. Jack fled into the woods before Haggard saw through the ruse. In Defias hands, the emblem of Stormwind authority could let outlaws pass checkpoints or confuse local patrols.

faq.answer: It is an official badge of rank Marshal Haggard carried while serving the kingdom of Stormwind. Even in retirement, such a badge carries genuine authority.

faq.q: How did Dead-tooth Jack get the badge?
faq.answer: Dead-tooth Jack came to Marshal Haggard's home at night wearing a Stormwind tabard. Haggard mistook him for Marshal Dughan of Goldshire and handed over the badge when Jack asked for it.

faq.q: Why is the badge dangerous in the hands of the Defias?
aliases: why does jack want the badge
faq.answer: A Defias agent carrying the genuine badge and wearing a disguise could impersonate a high-ranking Stormwind official, bypass sentries, enter garrisons, or give false orders to town guards.
Dead-tooth Jack locked the badge in his strongbox at his campsite south of Marshal Haggard's farm in Elwynn Forest.

angles.text: As a warrior, recovering Haggard's badge proves your mettle to a veteran of Stormwind's military. He rewards promising warriors with well-maintained surplus arms from his fighting days.
As an Alliance member, retrieving the badge protects Stormwind's military command and keeps the Defias Brotherhood from undermining local defenses from within.
